entities.summary: Indian Institute of Technology Gandhinagar is a public technical university located in Gandhinagar, Gujarat, India and recognized as an Institute of National Importance by the Government of India. It was established in 2008 and operates over a roughly 400-acre, environmentally certified campus along the banks of the Sabarmati river.
